cohort: 1655 mothers with breech presentation who delivered at Muhimbili National Hospital in Dar-es-Salaam, Tanzania, between 1999 and 2010
finding: Vaginal delivery for breech presentation was associated with increased odds of perinatal death compared to cesarean delivery, but overall perinatal mortality did not improve due to an increase in stillbirths among vaginal breech deliveries.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery for breech presentation was associated with higher odds of perinatal death compared to cesarean delivery.
